description: Pass 1 of LUMEN - 'eight kinds of light'. Z-Image Turbo paints the eight keyframes the film is built from, one per shot, and MiniMax-Music3 writes two candidate scores (a pure instrumental and one with a wordless choir). Review these before running LumenFilm.json, which animates each still with MiniMax-H3 and cuts them to the score.

variables.still_1_dawn_lake: A perfectly still alpine lake at dawn, mirror-calm, reflecting jagged snow-capped granite peaks whose summits glow pink and gold with the first sunlight while the valley floor is still in cool blue shadow; thin veils of mist drifting low across the water; a few dark boulders and a weathered wooden jetty in the foreground; wide cinematic landscape photograph, ultra-sharp, natural colours, soft dawn light
variables.still_2_barley_wind: A golden barley field at morning golden hour, backlit by the low sun so every head of grain glows, the wind pressing the field into long waves, a single ancient oak on a low rise, drifting seed fluff and dust lit up in the light, a hazy blue ridge far in the distance; wide cinematic landscape photograph, warm natural light, sharp foreground stalks
variables.still_3_redwood_rays: Inside an old-growth redwood forest, thick shafts of sunlight cutting through morning fog between enormous russet trunks, lush sword ferns and moss on the forest floor, a small clear creek in the foreground, pollen glowing in the beams; cinematic photograph from a low angle looking slightly up, sharp detail, green and gold
variables.still_4_rainbow_falls: A tall waterfall plunging into a green plunge pool in a black basalt canyon, a full bright rainbow arcing through the drifting spray, wet dark rock and vivid moss, midday sun from behind the camera; cinematic landscape photograph, sharp, vibrant natural colours
variables.still_5_sunset_dunes: Vast rippled sand dunes at sunset, the knife-edge crest of the nearest dune lit warm orange against deep violet shadow, fine sand streaming off the ridge in the wind, ranks of dunes fading into golden haze toward the horizon; cinematic landscape photograph, wide, crisp ripple textures
variables.still_6_sky_lanterns: Thousands of glowing paper sky lanterns rising into a deep blue twilight sky above a calm river, their warm reflections shimmering on the water, a wooden boat and the silhouettes of a riverside village and a pagoda; cinematic photograph, wide shot, soft bokeh from the most distant lanterns
variables.still_7_glowing_surf: A tropical beach at night, waves breaking in glowing electric-blue bioluminescence on dark wet sand, the Milky Way blazing across the sky, silhouettes of palm trees at the edges of the frame; cinematic long-exposure landscape photograph, deep blues and bright cyan glow, sharp stars
variables.still_8_aurora_ice: A vivid aurora borealis in green, violet and magenta curtains rippling over a frozen lake whose glass-clear black ice reflects the whole sky, snow-dusted mountains on the horizon, one lone dark pine at the shore, stars between the curtains; cinematic wide landscape photograph, sharp, rich colours
variables.score_prompt: Genre: cinematic orchestral, neoclassical. BPM: 60. Key: D major. Emotional progression: hushed and expectant at the open, blooming into a warm, soaring, awe-struck swell in the middle, and settling into a luminous, resolved calm at the end. Listening scenario: the score under a wordless nature film about light. Production profile: wide, lush concert-hall reverb, pristine, dynamic, no compression. Arrangement: a soft solo piano motif over a sustained low string pad opens; cellos and violas enter, then full strings and French horns lift into a broad soaring theme; a gentle harp and glockenspiel shimmer on top; the ending returns to the solo piano with a long held string chord. No drums, no percussion beat.
